title: A Log-Gaussian Scale-Space Limiter for Hybrid Continuum--Ballistic Gas Dynamics
summary: We propose a log-Gaussian scale-space limiter for hybrid continuum--ballistic gas dynamics. The method defines complementary continuum and ballistic weights as Gaussian cumulative probabilities in logarithmic Knudsen-number space and blends Navier--Stokes--Fourier and half-range Maxwellian kinetic fluxes. The method is formulated as a lightweight hybrid closure intended for future implementation in finite-volume, discrete Boltzmann, or gas-kinetic solvers.
